description:
Format a citation for one paper as BibTeX, RIS or APA 7. The URL is the paper's NobleID ARK
        when it has a confirmed one, else its DOI. DOIs known to be unreliable are left out rather than guessed.

format.description: bibtex, ris or apa (APA 7, plain text).
format.title: Format

identifier.description: A NobleBlocks paper id (the `id` from a search), a DOI (10.xxxx/...), a NobleID ARK (ark:/48914/...), an OpenAlex id (W...), 'pmid:<number>', 'arxiv:<id>' or a trial registry id (NCT...).
identifier.title: Identifier

name: get_citation
title: Get citation
